tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You recently attended a workshop on digital marketing and found it to be veryinformative. You want to thank the presenter, Ms. Clark, and ask for additional resourcesto further your understanding of the topic.
Write an email to Ms. Clark. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Provide a detailed explanation of why you found the workshop to be informative.
Ask for additional resources or recommendations for further study.
tasks.to: Ms. Clark Subject: Appreciation and request for additional resources
tasks.subject: Appreciation and request for additional resources
tasks.title: Write an Email
